paintDesc: Polestars fargekoder med Volvo-ekvivalenter. Polestar og Volvo deler lakkeringsfabrikk – fargene er identiske på tvers av merkene.
paintExplainer: Polestar og Volvo lakkerer bilene sine på samme fabrikk med identiske fargeresepter. Fargekodene deles på tvers av merkene – en Polestar med fargekode 729 har nøyaktig samme farge som en Volvo med kode 729. Navnene avviker av markedsføringshensyn, men den kjemiske sammensetningen er identisk. Det betyr at lakkstift, omlakkering og fargetilpasning kan gjøres med enten Polestars eller Volvos fargekoder om hverandre.
allMY21: Alle MY21-biler ble levert med Plus- og Pilot-pakkene som standard.
allMY25: Alle MY25- og MY26-biler leveres med Plus- og Pilot-pakkene som standard.
trademark: Polestar og alle relaterte merker tilhører Polestar. Dette er en uavhengig fellesskapsressurs uten tilknytning til Polestar.
noMatch: Ingen funksjoner samsvarer med de valgte filtrene.
homeSubtitle: Den komplette kjøpsguiden og eierressursen for Polestar 2. Sammenlign spesifikasjoner på tvers av modellår, utforsk kjente problemer og finn alt du trenger å vite.
homeSpecsDesc: Sammenlign spesifikasjoner på tvers av alle modellår fra MY21 til MY26. Filtrer per kategori og tilvalgspakke.
homeKnownIssuesDesc: Vanlige programvare-, el- og mekaniske feil med gjør-det-selv-tiltak og verkstedshandlinger.
homePrintingDesc: Fellesskapsskapte CAD-filer, materialguider for 3D-utskrift og utskrivbare tilbehør for din Polestar 2.
homeChargingDesc: Ladekurver for hurtiglading (DC), AC-ladespesifikasjoner, batteriforvarming og langsiktig batteripleie.
knownIssuesDesc: Vanlige programvare-, el- og mekaniske feil på Polestar 2, med diagnostikk, gjør-det-selv-tiltak og kjente verkstedshandlinger.
knownIssuesDisclaimer: Denne informasjonen er sammenstilt fra fellesskapsrapporter og servicebulletiner i utdanningsøyemed. Ettersom rapportene bygger på frivillige eieropplysninger kan problemenes nøyaktige frekvens ikke fastslås. Henvend deg alltid til et autorisert Polestar-verksted for diagnose og reparasjon. Arbeid på høyspenningssystemet skal kun utføres av opplærte teknikere.
serviceMaintenanceDisclaimer: Denne guiden tilbys kun i utdannings- og informasjonsøyemed. Å utføre eget vedlikehold kan medføre sikkerhetsrisiko og kan ugyldiggjøre bilens garantier. Følg alltid lokale sikkerhetsforskrifter, bruk egnet verneutstyr og konsulter den offisielle verkstedsinformasjonen (VIDA) for fullstendige prosedyrer og sikkerhetsanvisninger.
chargingDisclaimer: Ladeytelsen, ladekurvene og estimeringsverdiene som vises her er modeller basert på gjennomsnittsforhold, produsentspesifikasjoner og eierrapporterte data. Reelle ladehastigheter og ladetider vil variere avhengig av batteritemperatur, batteritilstand (SoH), ladekapasitet, værforhold og andre miljøfaktorer. Se alltid den offisielle kjøretøydokumentasjonen og laderens veiledning.
printingDesc: Et bibliotek med CAD-filer, materialanbefalinger, produksjonsmetoder og aktive fellesskapsprosjekter spesifikke for Polestar 2.
materialWarning: Bilmiljøet utsetter utskrevne deler for sterk UV-stråling og kupétemperaturer som kan overstige 80 °C. Standardfilament som PLA og PETG er derfor uegnet da de risikerer varmedeformasjon.
batteryCalibration: Etter frakobling eller bytte av 12V-batteriet må vindusheisenes one-touch-funksjon kalibreres på nytt. Hold vindusknappen i opp-stilling i 5 sekunder etter at vinduet er helt lukket for å reindeksere klembeskyttelsessensorene.
dcChargingIntro: Maksimal ladeytelse varierer avhengig av batterigenerasjon og drivlinjekonfigurasjon.
chargingCurveIntro: Batteristyringssystemet (BMS) justerer kontinuerlig ladeeffekten basert på batteritemperatur, ladenivå (SoC) og cellebeskyttelseskrav.
dcChargingOutro: Av den grunn avsluttes DC-hurtiglading vanligvis ved rundt 80 % SoC for maksimal ladehastighet under langdistansereiser.
acChargingIntro: For hjemme- og destinasjonslading bruker Polestar 2 en innebygd lader som omformer vekselstrøm fra strømnettet til likestrøm for batteriet.
acChargingOutro: Den faktiske ladetiden avhenger av batterikapasitet, strømstyrke, omgivelsestemperatur og bilens tilstand.
preconditioningIntro: For å oppnå maksimal DC-ladeytelse i kulde kan batteriet forvarmes før ankomst til ladestasjonen.
preconditioningNativeMaps: Batteriforvarming aktiveres ved å navigere til en DC-hurtiglader med bilens innebygde Google Maps (Android Automotive).
preconditioningAutoPrepare: Bilen forbereder automatisk batteriet for optimal ladeytelse før ankomst.
preconditioningThirdParty: Tredjepartsnavigasjon og mobilprojeksjonssystemer initierer ikke batteriforvarming.
preconditioningFactors: Forvarmingens effektivitet avhenger av faktorer som utetemperatur, kjøretid, batteriets utgangstemperatur og ruteforhold.
withoutHeatPumpDesc: Biler som mangler Plus-pakken bruker elektrisk motstandsvarme for kupeoppvarming og termikkstyring.
withHeatPumpDesc: Biler utstyrt med Plus-pakken har en varmepumpe som kan forbedre den totale energieffektiviteten ved å utnytte omgivelsesvarme og spillvarme fra kjøretøyets systemer.
heatPumpBenefit1: Redusert energiforbruk til klimaanlegg under mange driftsforhold.
heatPumpBenefit2: Forbedret vintereffektivitet sammenlignet med rene motstandsvarmede systemer.
heatPumpBenefit3: Potensielt lengre rekkevidde i kjøligere vær.
heatPumpVariability: De faktiske effektivitetsgevinstene varierer avhengig av temperatur, luftfuktighet, hastighet og klimasystemets innstillinger.
cableLockingDesc: Ved minusgrader kan isdannelse rundt ladekontakten eller låsemekanismen forhindre korrekt låsing.
lockingAction2: Forvarm bilen før lading når det er mulig.
lockingAction3: Sørg for at kontakten er ordentlig trykket inn før lading startes.
emergencyReleaseDesc: Hvis ladekabelen forblir låst på grunn av bilfeil, ladestasjonsfeil eller bortfall av 12V-strøm, finnes det en manuell frigjøringsmekanisme.
releaseStep4: Finn nødfrigjøringshåndtaket på venstre side under gulvet.
releaseStep5: Trekk håndtaket bestemt for å manuelt dra inn ladekontaktens låsesplint.
emergencyReleaseOutro: Undersøk alltid årsaken til låst ladekabel etter bruk av nødfrigjøringen.
nmcIntro: Polestar 2 bruker et litiumionebatteri av NMC-type (nikkel-mangan-kobolt). Riktige lade- og oppbevaringsrutiner bidrar til å opprettholde batteritilstanden over tid.
dailyUse1: For rutinekjøring velger mange eiere en ladegrense på rundt 80–90 %.
dailyUse2: Lad til 100 % hovedsakelig når maksimal rekkevidde kreves og bilen skal kjøres kort tid etter.
dailyUse3: Unngå å la bilen stå på 100 % SoC over lengre tid uten behov.
deepDischarge1: Unngå å oppbevare bilen med svært lavt ladenivå.
deepDischarge2: Hvis batteriet blir dypt utladet, lad bilen så snart det er praktisk mulig.
chargingStrategy1: AC-lading er generelt den foretrukne metoden for rutinlading.
chargingStrategy2: DC-hurtiglading støttes godt av bilen, men er mest nyttig under langdistansereiser.
storageOneToThreeMonths: Ved oppbevaring i én til tre måneder
storageShort1: La batteriet ligge på rundt 40–60 % SoC.
storageLong1: Koble bilen til en AC-ladekilde om mulig.
storageLong3: Kontroller regelmessig at ladingen forblir aktiv.
environmentalIntro: Ekstreme temperaturer kan påvirke batteriytelse og ladeatferd.
environmental1: Unngå langvarig eksponering for ekstrem varme når det er mulig.
environmental2: Følg produsentens anbefalinger angående ladenivå og ladetilkoblingsstatus.
environmental3: Oppbevar bilen skjermet når det er praktisk mulig.
batteryHealthIntro: Basert på Polestars offisielle retningslinjer og NMC-kjemiens beste praksis, bidrar følgende anbefalinger til å bevare batterikapasitet og maksimere levetiden.
socDailyLimitDesc: Polestar anbefaler offisielt en ladegrense på 90 % for daglig kjøring. Dette stilles inn i midtdisplayet under ladeinnstillinger.
socRoadTripsDesc: Lad til 100 % kun når full rekkevidde kreves og bilen skal kjøres straks etterpå. Unngå å la bilen stå på 100 % over lange perioder.
socLowWarningDesc: Hvis SoC faller under 20 % anbefales alltid lading. Batteriet kan skades alvorlig hvis det etterlates helt utladet, ettersom standby-forbruk og selvutlading kan drive det til 0 %.
socSweetSpotDesc: For maksimal levetid velger mange eiere å holde batteriet mellom 20 % og 90 % SoC for daglig bruk – noe som dekker omtrent 70 % av brukbar kapasitet.
batteryWarrantyDesc: Polestar garanterer at høyspenningsbatteriet beholder minst 70 % av sin opprinnelige kapasitet i 8 år eller 160 000 km (100 000 miles), avhengig av hva som inntreffer først.
batteryWarrantyReplace: Hvis batteritilstanden (SoH) faller under 70 % innen garantiperioden, erstatter Polestar batteriet uten ekstra kostnad.
batteryWarrantyCert: Bruktbiler av Polestar 2 får nå et offisielt sertifikat for batteritilstand (BSOH), som viser gjenværende brukbar kapasitet i prosent (f.eks. >95 %).
extremeTempHot1: Unngå å utsette bilen for temperaturer rundt 55 °C (131 °F) i mer enn 24 timer – alvorlig batteriskade kan oppstå.
extremeTempHot2: Unngå om mulig å la bilen stå frakoblet ved over 30 °C (86 °F). Batteriet kan aktivt kjøles ved parkering, men dette tapper SoC.
extremeTempHot3: Parker i skyggen i varmt vær. Sterkt sollys kombinert med høy omgivelsestemperatur kan overopphete batteripakken.
extremeTempCold1: Ved lave temperaturer reduseres batteriytelsen midlertidig inntil pakken er varmet opp. Bruk forvarming mens bilen er tilkoblet lader.
extremeTempCold2: Hvis bilen parkeres i mer enn 24 timer under -30 °C (-22 °F), hold kjøretøyet tilkoblet en ladekilde.
extremeTempCold3: Å kjøre med redusert ytelse på grunn av kulde skader ikke batteriet – det er en normal beskyttelsesatferd.
acVsDcDesc: Velg om mulig og tidsmessig hensiktsmessig AC-lading fremfor DC-hurtiglading. AC-lading er mer skånsomt for høyspenningsbatteriet, særlig ved regelmessig daglig lading. Reserver DC-hurtiglading for langdistansereiser.
batteryChemistryIntro: Polestar 2 produseres med to forskjellige litiumionebatterikjemier avhengig av batteristørrelse og modellår. Hver kjemi har spesifikke ladeegenskaper og vedlikeholdsretningslinjer.
lfpDesc: Finnes i 2024+ Facelift Standard Range-modeller (69 kWh batteripakke). LFP-kjemien er ekstremt slitesterk, motstandsdyktig mot termisk runaway og håndterer høyt ladenivå svært godt.
lfpRecDesc: Lad til 100 % minst én gang i uken. En ladegrense på 100 % er fullt akseptabelt for daglig bruk. Regelmessig fullading lar BMS-en kalibrere cellespenningene og rapportere ladenivået korrekt.
nmcTitle: NMC (nikkel-mangan-kobolt) – Long Range & Standard Range før 2024
nmcDesc: Finnes i samtlige Long Range-modeller (78 kWh / 82 kWh) samt Standard Range før faceliften (64 kWh / 69 kWh). NMC-kjemien gir høyere energitetthet, men rammes av akselerert degradering om den holdes på høy SoC.
nmcRecDesc: Begrens daglig lading til 90 % SoC. Lad til 100 % kun før avreise på langturer. Prøv å unngå at ladingen faller under 20 % over lengre perioder.
estimatorIntro: Beregn estimerte ladetider, tilført energi og rekkevidde basert på reelle ladekurver. Juster parameterne nedenfor for å simulere din ladeøkt.
searchIssuesPlaceholder: Søk etter problemer, symptomer eller tilbakestillinger...
retrofitsDesc: En sammenstilt guide for offisielle ettermonteringer, ettermarkedsmodifikasjoner, gjør-det-selv-oppgraderinger og programvarekodingsalternativer for Polestar 2.
perfSoftwareDesc: Offisiell Polestar-programvareøkning for Long Range Dual Motor-varianter. Merk: Denne sammenligningen (300 kW til 350 kW / 660 Nm til 680 Nm) gjelder modeller før facelift (MY21–MY23). For MY24+ facelift-modeller øker oppgraderingen effekten fra 310 kW (421 hk) til 350 kW (476 hk) mens dreiemomentet forblir på 740 Nm.
orbitGuideDesc: Orbit er et tredjepartsverktøy som lar eiere koble seg til sin Polestar 2 via OBD2-porten for å konfigurere bilens innstillinger direkte. Populære modifikasjoner inkluderer:
pixelActivation: Aktivering av Pixel Active High Beam (for Pilot Lite-pakker eller regionalt deaktiverte markeder)
pilotAssistEnable: Aktivering av Pilot Assist / Adaptiv cruisekontroll (hvis maskinvarekomponenter finnes)
regionChange: Justeringer av regional lysatferd og låsebekreftelsesinnstillinger
obdHardwareDesc: En OBDLink MX+ Bluetooth-adapter, eller en ENET-kabel kombinert med en USB-C til Ethernet-adapter, koblet til en datamaskin med Orbit installert.
retrofitsDisclaimer: Alle ettermarkedsmodifikasjoner, tredjepartskoding (som Orbit) og gjør-det-selv-installasjoner medfører iboende risiko. Visse endringer kan ugyldiggjøre produsentgarantier, påvirke kjøretøysikkerhetens typegodkjenninger eller overskrives ved offisielle OTA-programvareoppdateringer. Gjør alltid grundige undersøkelser, gå forsiktig frem og konsulter sertifiserte teknikere ved behov.
issues_ihu_instability_symptoms: UI lag, boot loops, system crashes due to Android Automotive OS memory leaks.
issues_ihu_instability_diy: Soft Reset: Hold home button below screen for 20 seconds.\nHard Reset: Recovery menu factory reset (requires VIDA key re-pairing).
issues_tcam_failure_symptoms: Total loss of LTE, GPS, eCall, and Phone-as-Key (PAK) connection.
issues_tcam_failure_diy: Rechargeable backup battery located under the rear headliner.
issues_rearview_camera_glitch_symptoms: Rearview backup camera image fails to render or remains blank when shifting into reverse.
issues_rearview_camera_glitch_diy: Verify camera lens is clean. If screen is black, perform IHU soft reset (hold Home button below screen for 20 seconds).
issues_rear_axle_click_symptoms: Low-speed clicking/ticking from rear. Often misdiagnosed as CV joints; root cause is often ERAD internal wear.
issues_rear_axle_click_diy: Torque-to-yield stretch bolt. Must be replaced whenever removed (single-use).
issues_front_suspension_knocking_symptom: Popping/grinding during low-speed steering over uneven surfaces. Premature strut top bearing wear.
issues_front_suspension_knocking_diy: Front upper suspension bearing and mount assembly. Recommended to replace in pairs.
issues_propeller_shaft_vibration_symptom: Vibration/shudder felt through the cabin or steering wheel during moderate acceleration between 50 and 70 km/h.
issues_propeller_shaft_vibration_diy: Diagnostic check: Inspect motor mounts and driveshaft alignment for play.
issues_12v_battery_drain_symptoms: Total vehicle immobilization. Contactor fails to close regardless of high-voltage pack state of charge.
issues_12v_battery_drain_diy: OEM H5 AGM battery. Can be replaced with premium aftermarket H5 AGM battery equivalents.
issues_hvch_failure_symptoms: Loss of cabin heat, "Parking Climate Temporarily Unavailable" error. Blown 15A inverter fuse.
issues_hvch_failure_diy: Updated heater unit revision. Sourced to fix failure-prone initial 2021 parts.
issues_power_inverter_failure_symptoms: Sudden loss of propulsion while driving, "Propulsion system urgent service required" dashboard warning, or failure to start.
issues_power_inverter_failure_diy: No DIY action: High-voltage system hazard. Pull over safely and arrange towing to a service point.
issues_blend_door_actuator_symptoms: Extreme temperature delta across zones (e.g., hot driver, cold passenger), rapid dashboard clicking.
issues_blend_door_actuator_diy: Electric actuator motor controlling HVAC flaps (shared with Volvo XC40).
issues_door_latch_freezing_symptoms: Rear exterior/interior handles freeze shut or fail to latch below -10 °C. Factory grease inadequacy.
issues_door_latch_freezing_diy: Updated latch with improved moisture seals and low-temperature grease.
issues_lamp_condensation_symptoms: Visible moisture build-up, misting, or water droplets inside the front headlamps or rear light bar.
issues_lamp_condensation_diy: Inspect and clean ventilation caps on back of assemblies. Temporary misting is normal and should clear on drive.
issues_tailgate_spindle_failure_symptoms: Tailgate makes a loud grinding, squeaking, or groaning noise during operation. It may open halfway and reverse, or fail to open/close under power.
issues_tailgate_spindle_failure_diy: Passenger side motorized lift strut. Replaced as a matched pair.
noIssuesMatch: Ingen problemer samsvarer med de valgte filtrene.
partNumberDisclaimer: ⚠ Artikkelnumre kan erstattes uten forvarsel. Bekreft alltid korrekt nummer ved å oppgi ditt VIN hos et autorisert Polestar-verksted eller Volvo Parts-portal.
milestone_my21_summary: Introduksjonsåret for Polestar 2, lansert eksklusivt som en høyytende Dual Motor-variant.
milestone_my21_bullet0: AWD-drivlinje med dobbelmotor (300 kW / 408 hk) som standard.
milestone_my21_bullet1: Plus- og Pilot-pakker standardutstyr på samtlige biler.
milestone_my21_bullet2: Høyglanssort takseksjon og Pixel LED-frontlykter inkludert.
milestone_my21_bullet3: 78 kWh batterikapasitet med støtte for opptil 150 kW DC-lading.
milestone_my22_summary: Introduksjon av forhjulsdrevne Single Motor-varianter samt oppdeling av utstyrspakker i separate tilvalg.
milestone_my22_bullet0: Lansering av Standard Range (opprinnelig 64 kWh, oppgradert til 69 kWh mars 2022) og Long Range (78 kWh) Single Motor FWD-alternativer.
milestone_my22_bullet1: Plus- og Pilot-pakker adskilt som egne tilvalg.
milestone_my22_bullet2: Innføring av Performance-pakke som tilvalg samt frittstående ventilert Nappa-skinnoppgradering.
milestone_my22_bullet3: Varmepumpe innført som del av den valgfrie Plus-pakken.
milestone_my23_summary: Inkrementelle battericelleoppdateringer som økte effektiviteten, sammen med nye lakkfarger og felgdesign.
milestone_my23_bullet0: Optimalisert cellekjemi økte rekkevidden marginalt på Standard Range.
milestone_my23_bullet1: Nye utvendige lakkeringer: Space (metallicsvart) og Jupiter (gullgrå metallic).
milestone_my23_bullet2: Oppdatert design på standard 19-tommers samt valgfrie 20-tommers felger.
milestone_my23_bullet3: Luftkvalitetssensor for kupeen (PM2.5) lagt til i Plus-pakken.
milestone_my24_summary: En massiv arkitektonisk modernisering: Single Motor-modeller byttet fra FWD til bakhjulsdrift (RWD) med neste generasjons motorer.
milestone_my24_bullet0: Skifte fra FWD til RWD-layout, noe som dramatisk forbedrer veigrep og fremkommelighet.
milestone_my24_bullet1: Neste generasjons høyeffektive inverter og motorer, som øker topprekkevidden med opptil 22 % og forbedrer akselerasjonen.
milestone_my24_bullet2: Ny CATL 82 kWh-batteripakke for Long Range løfter maksimal DC-lading til 205 kW.
milestone_my24_bullet3: SmartZone-skjoldet erstatter gittergrillen og huser frontradar og kameraer.
milestone_my25_summary: Visuell finpuss og omorganisering av tilvalgspakker for mer frittstående tilpasning.
milestone_my25_bullet0: Harman Kardon premiumlyd skilt ut fra Plus-pakken og gjort til et separat tilvalg.
milestone_my25_bullet1: Climate-pakke innført, som samler varme bakseter, varmt ratt og varmepumpe.
milestone_my25_bullet2: Ny farge Storm samt oppdaterte interiørbetrekk.
milestone_my25_bullet3: Plus- og Pilot-pakker atter standard på sent produserte biler i utvalgte markeder.
milestone_my26_summary: Større prosessoroppgradering til Qualcomm Snapdragon samt innføring av avanserte lydalternativer.
milestone_my26_bullet0: Ny Qualcomm Snapdragon-infotainmentprosessor forbedrer systemresponsiviteten dramatisk.
milestone_my26_bullet1: Innføring av Bowers & Wilkins 14-høyttalers (1 350 W) premiumlydsystem som tilvalg.
milestone_my26_bullet2: Ny CATL-batteripakke på 70 kWh erstatter tidligere 69 kWh for Standard Range.
milestone_my26_bullet3: Standard Ranges maksimallading hevet til 180 kW (fra 135 kW).
service_sriResetSteps:
1. Sitt i førersetet og lukk alle dører.
2. Fest sikkerhetsbeltet for å unngå forstyrrende varsellyder.
3. Hold fartsholderens minus-knapp (-) inne på rattets venstre side.
4. Mens minusknappen holdes inne, trå på bremsepedalen og sett girvelgeren i D (kjøregir).
5. Slipp bremsepedalen umiddelbart (kjør ikke!), men fortsett å holde minusknappen (-) inne.
6. Vent ca. 10 sekunder til det oransje "i"-symbolet (informasjon) i førerdisplayet begynner å blinke. Slipp minusknappen umiddelbart.
7. Trykk på OK-/senterknappen på rattets høyre side for å bekrefte tilbakestillingen.
service_hubAxleBoltNote: Engangsartikkel (strekkbolt); skift ut ved hver demontering.
service_hubCenterBoreNote: Krever navsentrerte hjul eller sentreringsringer ved ettermarkedsfelger.
service_transmissionOilNote: Bruk Volvo/Polestars transmisjonsolje (SAE 75W-90 / API GL-5). Skift hver 80 000–100 000 km for lang levetid.
service_coolantSystemCapacityNote: Bruk fabrikkblandet Volvo Green Coolant 50/50 (type VCS). Spyling krever avlufting via VIDA.
service_brakeFluidNote: Lavviskositetsvariant å foretrekke for bedre ABS-/stabilitetsrespons i kaldt klima.
service_acRefrigerantNote: Varierer strengt etter regionalt produksjonsmål; kontroller spesifikasjonsetiketten på undersiden av panseret.
service_cabinAirFilterPurpose: Multifilter med aktivt kull; anbefalt utskifting hvert annet år.
service_12vAuxBatteryPurpose: Standard LN3 H6 AGM; anbefalt utskifting hver 36. måned for å forebygge TCAM-/12V-utladninger.
service_cleanWindshield: Rengjør innsiden av frontruten foran kamera
service_wheelsTiresCheck: Hjul og dekk, kontroll av slitasje & trykk
charging_phaseDesc1: Highest charging rates are typically available when battery temperature is within the optimal range.
charging_phaseDesc2: Charging power gradually tapers as SoC increases.
charging_phaseDesc4: Charging power decreases significantly to protect battery longevity and minimize cell stress.
charging_takeaway0: Long Range Polestar 2 models support up to 150 kW or 205 kW DC charging depending on generation.
charging_takeaway1: AC charging supports up to 11 kW on a three-phase connection.
charging_takeaway2: Battery preconditioning requires navigation to a DC charger using the vehicle's native Google Maps system.
charging_takeaway3: Charging speed naturally tapers as battery state of charge increases.
charging_takeaway4: Polestar officially recommends a 90% charge limit for daily use; charge to 100% only when full range is needed.
charging_takeaway5: Avoid letting SoC fall below 20% — deep discharge can cause serious battery damage.
charging_takeaway6: AC charging is preferred for daily use; reserve DC fast charging for long-distance travel.
charging_takeaway7: Long-term storage is best performed with the battery maintained around 40–60% state of charge.
charging_takeaway8: The 8-year / 160,000 km battery warranty guarantees at least 70% of original capacity.
charging_takeaway9: The emergency charging cable release is located beneath the cargo floor on the left side.
print_cupholderArmrestDesc: Double cupholder supporting 330 ml cans and an elevated armrest extension.
print_cupholderArmrestOrient: Print face down to avoid supports on the main armrest segment.
print_magsafeMountDesc: Bracket fitting around the center screen with interchangeable phone holders.
print_magsafeMountOrient: Print on its side to maximize layer line strength around the screen clip area.
print_usbShelfTidyDesc: Shelf insert for the USB port area to reclaim space, featuring cable pass-through notches.
print_usbShelfTidyOrient: Print flat on the bed. No support material required.
print_chargePortCoverDesc: Protective cover fitting precisely over the charging area to prevent snow and debris accumulation.
print_chargePortCoverOrient: Print with the weather seal face flat against the build plate.
print_speakerAdaptersDesc: Aftermarket speaker adapters compatible with the Polestar 2 and Volvo XC40.
print_speakerAdaptersOrient: Print flat. Enable brim if printing with PC to prevent corner warping.
print_keyFobShellDesc: Custom lightweight and textured replacement shells for the bulky OEM key fob, featuring exact fit tolerances.
print_keyFobShellOrient: Print flat on the main outer face; use a textured bed sheet for a high-end matte OEM-like finish.
print_trunkCargoHooksDesc: Heavy-duty clip-on bag hanger hooks designed to slide into the trunk side liner slots to secure bags.
print_trunkCargoHooksOrient: Print flat on its side so the layer lines run parallel to the hook curve for maximum load capacity.
print_consoleStorageDividerDesc: Drop-in slot divider insert to partition the deep center armrest compartment for cards, sunglasses, and keys.
print_consoleStorageDividerOrient: Print flat on its bottom face. No support material required.
print_parcelShelfClipsDesc: High-tolerance replacements for the fragile plastic string clips that secure the rear parcel cargo shelf.
print_parcelShelfClipsOrient: Print vertically with the slot facing upwards. Enable a small brim to stabilize the print.
print_revEngTip1Desc: Utilize photogrammetry or reference scaling from module photographs to build initial CAD wireframes for custom trim.
print_revEngTip2Desc: Apply standardized dimensions for replicating factory mounting clips to secure custom components without permanent modifications.
print_revEngTip3Desc: Apply scaling compensation factors within the slicer or CAD software to account for material shrinkage when printing functional engineering filaments like PC or ASA.
print_matGuidelineAsaDesc: Recommended for interior trim and exterior components. Provides high UV resistance, thermal stability, and a matte finish suitable for matching OEM aesthetics.
print_matGuidelinePcDesc: Required for structural components, parts exposed to high mechanical stress, or extreme temperature environments.
print_matGuidelineTpuDesc: Optimal for cup holder inserts, gaskets, or vibration-dampening mounts.
print_advisorDesc: Answer three quick questions about your printer setup and project to find the correct printing material.
print_recTPUDesc: TPU is ideal for flexible, vibration-dampening components like cup holders or gaskets. It is easy to print on open-frame printers as it has very low shrinkage.
print_recASAExteriorDesc: ASA is the best choice for exterior parts. It features outstanding UV/weather resistance and high thermal limits, but requires a closed enclosure and high bed temperature (100°C+) to prevent warping.
print_recPETGExteriorDesc: Since you lack an enclosure or high bed temp, PETG is the safest choice for exterior parts. It has decent natural UV resistance, but we recommend spraying the finished part with a UV-blocking clear coat for longevity.
print_recASAInteriorDesc: ASA is highly recommended for cabin panels. Temperatures inside a parked cabin in direct sun can exceed 70°C, causing PLA to warp. ASA withstands this heat and matches the matte OEM plastic texture.
print_recPETGInteriorDesc: Without an enclosure, PETG is the best choice for cabin interior parts. It withstands up to 75°C, which is sufficient for parts not in direct dashboard sunlight. Avoid standard PLA inside the cabin.
print_recPCMechanicalDesc: Polycarbonate (PC) provides extreme strength, mechanical stiffness, and very high thermal resistance (110°C+). Ideal for speaker adapters. Requires hot nozzles (270°C+) and a heated chamber.
print_recPETGMechDesc: For mechanical parts without an enclosure, print with PETG using extra perimeters (5-6 walls) and 40%+ infill. This provides great impact resistance and is significantly stronger than PLA.
print_warpStep1Desc: Before printing ASA or PC, turn your heated bed to 100°C–110°C and let the enclosed printer sit idle for 15–20 minutes. This preheats the ambient chamber air, drastically reducing thermal shock stresses that pull corners off the bed.
print_warpStep2Desc: High-shrinkage filaments require active adhesion. Apply specialized adhesive (such as Magigoo, ABS juice/slurry, or standard glue stick) onto a clean textured PEI plate. This provides the chemical bond necessary to lock down warping corners.
print_warpStep3Desc: If your printer is only semi-enclosed, turn on the "Draft Shield" (or wind shield) option in your slicer. This prints a sacrificial single-walled shroud around your model, blocking cooling drafts from hitting the printed object.
print_noMatchFilters: No models match the selected filters.
retrofit_pixelLedTitle: Pixel Active High Beam Software Enable (US/Canada)
retrofit_pixelLedDesc: Enable steering-responsive adaptive headlights that dynamically dim individual pixel sections to prevent glare for oncoming drivers. This software deactivation was specific to North American (US/Canada) vehicles due to old FMVSS 108 regulatory bans. Note that the physical Pixel LED hardware must be present (MY21 Launch Edition or MY22-MY23 Pilot pack). Cars with Pilot Lite packages lack the hardware arrays.
retrofit_pixelLedWarning: Adaptive beam functions were disabled by default on US/Canadian cars. Enabling this feature via CCF modification will be overwritten whenever the vehicle receives an official OTA software update from Polestar, requiring you to re-apply the coding change.
retrofit_pixelLedStep1: Verify physical headlamps feature the "Polestar Pixel Technology" lettering on the inner bezel.
retrofit_pixelLedStep2: Connect an OBD2 cable/adapter to the vehicle OBD port.
retrofit_pixelLedStep3: Use third-party Car Configuration File (CCF) editing tools (like Orbit) to change the Headlight Configuration value to Pixel Adaptive.
retrofit_pixelLedStep4: Perform an ECU reset (CEM and VMCU) to apply and index the new headlight settings.
retrofit_kickSensorDesc: Retrofit the Foot Movement Detection Module (FMDM) that was omitted from select late MY22 and early MY23 Polestar 2 vehicles due to the global semiconductor shortage. Some affected vehicles have the rear bumper wiring harness pre-installed with a dummy connector, but many do not — the harness may lack the required Power, Ground, and LIN bus lines. After hardware installation, the Central Electronic Module (CEM) must be software-configured to recognize the new sensor before the kick-to-open function will activate.
retrofit_kickSensorWarning: This is not a simple plug-and-play installation. The FMDM communicates over the LIN bus with the CEM, and incorrect wiring can cause tailgate system faults or interfere with other vehicle modules. Modifying CEM configuration may affect your warranty. Check with your Polestar Service Point first — many affected vehicles are eligible for a free official retrofit under an open service campaign.
retrofit_kickSensorPn1Note: Primary OEM part. May be superseded — verify with VIN.
retrofit_kickSensorPn2Note: Earlier revision number referenced in some service bulletins.
retrofit_kickSensorStep1: Contact your Polestar Service Point with your VIN to check eligibility for a free factory retrofit campaign before attempting a DIY installation.
retrofit_kickSensorStep2: Purchase the FMDM module and dual antenna sensor tubes. Ensure your 12V battery is fully charged or connected to a maintainer.
retrofit_kickSensorStep3: Remove the lower rear bumper valence panel to access the sensor mounting area and bumper wiring harness.
retrofit_kickSensorStep4: Inspect the harness for a pre-existing dummy connector. If absent, you will need to run Power, Ground, and LIN bus wires from the rear fuse box area to the bumper — consult vehicle-specific wiring diagrams for your model year.
retrofit_kickSensorStep5: Mount the FMDM antenna tubes into the retaining clips on the inside of the bumper cover and connect the module to the harness.
retrofit_kickSensorStep6: Activate the kick sensor feature in the CEM using a CCF configuration tool (such as Orbit via OBD2) or have a Polestar Service Point enable it via VIDA. The hardware will not function without this software step.
retrofit_kickSensorStep7: Reassemble the bumper trim and test by standing within 1 meter of the rear bumper with the key fob and performing a foot-sweep motion under the center of the bumper.
retrofit_magsafeChargingDesc: The standard OEM wireless charging pad is slow, generates significant heat, and allows devices to slide off on turns. Upgrading to a custom 3D-printed MagSafe tray mount provides fast, stable charging and holds the phone securely.
retrofit_magsafeChargingStep1: Print or purchase a custom center console wireless charging replacement insert.
retrofit_magsafeChargingStep2: Insert a standard 15W MagSafe magnetic puck into the designated circular cutout.
retrofit_magsafeChargingStep3: Route the USB-C power wire under the trim to the console USB ports.
retrofit_magsafeChargingStep4: Place the assembly in the wireless charging slot for a flush, OEM-like look.
retrofit_mudflapsDesc: Polestar 2 paint is susceptible to stone chips and road debris damage along the lower sills and rear wheel arches due to the flared body styling. Fitted aftermarket mud guards offer subtle, functional protection.
retrofit_consoleInsertDesc: A drop-in divider tray designed specifically for the deep under-armrest storage well. It creates a practical upper shelf for sunglasses, keys, and coins while leaving the lower main compartment accessible.
retrofit_orbitObd2Desc: Modify your vehicle Car Configuration File (CCF) using Orbit software. This utility lets you connect your computer to the OBD port to unlock factory features that were disabled in your region, modify lighting patterns, or configure pilot package upgrades.
retrofit_orbitObd2Step1: Obtain a compatible OBD2 adapter (OBDLink MX+ or an ENET cable with a USB-C Ethernet adapter).
retrofit_orbitObd2Step2: Download Orbit and purchase a subscription license.
retrofit_orbitObd2Step3: Connect the adapter to the OBD2 port located in the driver-side footwell.
retrofit_orbitObd2Step4: Read current CCF configurations and make adjustments carefully. Keep a backup copy of your original configuration file.
retrofit_smartzoneGrilleTitle: Official SmartZone Front Panel Upgrade (Facelift Retrofit)
retrofit_smartzoneGrilleDesc: Replace the pre-facelift grid grille with the body-colored, flat SmartZone sensor panel introduced in the MY24 facelift. Offered in select markets (such as the UK) as an official aftermarket upgrade package, it refreshes the front-end styling while keeping the existing ADAS radar and front camera components functional.
retrofit_smartzoneGrilleWarning: This retrofit requires moving sensitive front camera and mid-range radar sensors into the new panel. If the sensors are misaligned during swap, safety systems (Pilot Assist, Collision Avoidance) will throw faults or fail. Proper professional calibration via VIDA at a certified Polestar Service Point is highly recommended.
retrofit_smartzonePn1Note: May be superseded. Color-specific variants exist — verify with VIN.
retrofit_smartzonePn2Note: Reference only — the part being replaced.
retrofit_smartzonePn3Note: May be superseded by 32315667 on later builds. Always confirm with your VIN.
retrofit_smartzoneStep1: Consult your local Polestar Extras shop or service center to confirm parts availability for your specific VIN.
retrofit_smartzoneStep2: Remove the front bumper assembly to access the grille mounting clips and sensor brackets.
retrofit_smartzoneStep3: Carefully disconnect the wiring harness and unbolt the mid-range radar and front parking camera from the original grille.
retrofit_smartzoneStep4: Install the new body-colored SmartZone cover panel and bolt the sensors into the new mounting bracket array.
retrofit_smartzoneStep5: Reassemble the front bumper and schedule a safety system calibration (VMCU and ADAS alignment) via Volvo/Polestar VIDA service software.
retrofit_towBarDesc: Retrofit the OEM semi-electric, retractable tow bar assembly onto vehicles not originally equipped. The system integrates with Trailer Stability Assist (TSA), automated trailer light checks, and dashboard trailer warnings. This is an extensive installation requiring bumper removal, chassis mounting, wiring harness routing from rear to front, and mandatory VIDA software activation at a Polestar Service Point.
retrofit_towBarWarning: This is a safety-critical component. The Trailer Module (TRM) must be activated via VIDA to integrate with the CAN bus — the hardware will not function without this dealer-performed software step. Aftermarket alternatives (e.g. EcoHitch) exist for bike rack use but lack electronic integration, TSA, and the folding mechanism.
retrofit_towBarPn1Note: Latest revision. Earlier revisions include 32207226, 32270344. Always confirm with VIN.
retrofit_towBarPn2Note: Harness routes from rear to front. May vary by model year.
retrofit_towBarStep1: Contact your Polestar Service Point with your VIN to order the correct tow bar kit and confirm software activation availability.
retrofit_towBarStep2: Remove the rear bumper fascia, rear diffuser panel, and undertray to access the chassis mounting points.
retrofit_towBarStep3: Install the tow bar frame assembly onto the chassis cross-member using the supplied bolts and torque to specification.
retrofit_towBarStep4: Route the trailer wiring harness from the rear connector through the underbody, interior floor channels, and into the front electrical junction box.
retrofit_towBarStep5: Reinstall the bumper fascia — the lower section may require a factory cutout or trimming to accommodate the folding mechanism.
retrofit_towBarStep6: Have a Polestar Service Point perform the mandatory VIDA software activation to register the Trailer Module (TRM) on the CAN bus and enable TSA and trailer light checks.
retrofit_fitcamxDashcamDesc: Replace the plastic sensor cover behind the rearview mirror with a FitCamX dash cam module that looks factory-integrated. The unit is designed specifically for the Polestar 2 and connects to the existing wiring harness for a clean, OEM-look installation with no visible cables. An optional rear camera can be added by routing a cable through the headliner.
retrofit_fitcamxDashcamStep1: Purchase the FitCamX kit for Polestar 2 (confirm your model year for correct fitment).
retrofit_fitcamxDashcamStep2: Carefully pry off the existing plastic sensor cover behind the rearview mirror using a non-marring trim tool.
retrofit_fitcamxDashcamStep3: Disconnect the factory harness connector and plug in the FitCamX adapter cable.
retrofit_fitcamxDashcamStep4: Snap the FitCamX camera module into place — it replaces the original cover for a seamless look.
retrofit_fitcamxDashcamStep5: Insert a microSD card and configure recording settings via the FitCamX app.
retrofit_fitcamxDashcamStep6: (Optional) Route the rear camera cable along the headliner, through the rubber conduit in the rear hatch, and mount the rear unit on the back glass.
retrofit_puddleLightsDesc: Swap the standard door puddle lights for custom projector modules that display the Polestar logo on the ground when the door opens. On vehicles equipped with factory door lights, this is a direct plug-and-play replacement — simply pull out the old light module and click in the new projector unit.
retrofit_puddleLightsWarning: If your specific trim did not include factory puddle lights, the necessary wiring may be absent behind the door cards. In that case, installation becomes significantly more complex and may require door panel removal and wiring work.
retrofit_puddleLightsStep1: Confirm your vehicle has factory door puddle lights by checking under the open door for existing light modules.
retrofit_puddleLightsStep2: Purchase projector units compatible with the Polestar 2 door light socket.
retrofit_puddleLightsStep3: Use a non-marring trim tool to carefully pry out the existing puddle light module from the door card.
retrofit_puddleLightsStep4: Insert the new projector module into the socket — it should click firmly into place.
retrofit_puddleLightsStep5: Open the door to test projection alignment and brightness on the ground.
retrofit_ceramicTintDesc: Apply professional-grade ceramic window tint to side windows and the panoramic glass roof for superior infrared heat rejection, 99% UV protection, and glare reduction. Ceramic film does not interfere with GPS, cellular, key fob, or Phone-as-Key signals — critical for the Polestar 2. The panoramic roof already has some factory UV filtering, but additional ceramic tint dramatically improves cabin comfort in warm climates and reduces HVAC load, helping preserve range.
retrofit_ceramicTintStep1: Choose a reputable ceramic tint brand and shade level (e.g. 35% sides, 70% windshield strip). Check local tint laws for your jurisdiction.
retrofit_ceramicTintStep2: Clean all glass surfaces thoroughly to ensure a lint- and debris-free bonding surface.
retrofit_ceramicTintStep3: Apply the film to side windows and rear glass using a wet application method with a slip solution.
retrofit_ceramicTintStep4: For the panoramic roof, use a single-piece film cut to match the glass dimensions. Work carefully to avoid bubbles and creases.
retrofit_ceramicTintStep5: Allow 3–5 days of curing time before rolling down windows. Avoid car washes during this period.
retrofit_frunkLedDesc: The Polestar 2 frunk lacks adequate factory lighting, making it difficult to see contents at night. A self-adhesive LED strip or battery-operated motion-sensing LED bar can be installed in minutes for dramatically improved visibility. For a permanent solution, tap into a switched 12V source using proper automotive connectors.
retrofit_frunkLedWarning: If you splice into the vehicle's 12V wiring, use proper automotive-grade connectors (e.g. TE connectors) rather than bare wire splices. Incorrect wiring in the frunk area could affect warranty coverage. Battery-operated alternatives avoid this risk entirely.
retrofit_frunkLedStep1: Choose your lighting method: self-adhesive LED strip (12V wired), USB-powered LED bar, or battery-operated motion-sensor light.
retrofit_frunkLedStep2: Clean the mounting surface inside the frunk lid or upper lip with isopropyl alcohol.
retrofit_frunkLedStep3: Peel the adhesive backing and firmly press the LED strip or light bar into place along the upper edge of the frunk opening.
retrofit_frunkLedStep4: For wired installations: route the power cable to a switched 12V source using proper TE or Posi-Tap connectors. For battery/USB: simply position the unit and ensure a secure mount.
retrofit_frunkLedStep5: Close and reopen the frunk to verify even illumination coverage.
retrofit_partNumberDisclaimer: ⚠ Part numbers may be superseded without notice. Always confirm the correct number by providing your VIN to an authorized Polestar Service Point or Volvo Parts portal.

spec_note_0: MY21–MY22 pre-March and MY26 came with 2 standard key fobs. MY22 post-March through MY25 came with 1 standard key fob. All years include a buttonless key tag (activity key) as standard.
spec_note_1: Waterproof to 10m for 60 minutes. Battery is not user-replaceable. Included as standard on all model years per Polestar owner's manual.
spec_note_2: Enabled via Bluetooth and the Polestar app. Added to all cars via OTA update from May 2021. Standard on all trims for MY21–MY23. Moved to Plus pack from MY24 onwards.
spec_note_3: Power-operated tailgate with soft close has been standard on all trims since launch. Never offered with a manual tailgate.
spec_note_4: Kick-to-open foot sensor was standard on all trims for MY21–MY23. Some MY22 cars omitted the sensor due to semiconductor shortages (retrofittable free of charge). Moved to Plus pack from MY24 onwards.
spec_note_5: MY26: Upgraded from Intel Atom A3960 to Snapdragon. Faster app loads, smoother UI, quicker downloads.
spec_note_6: Includes built-in Google Maps, Google Assistant, and Google Play Store. Polestar 2 was the world's first car with Android Automotive OS.
spec_note_7: Added via P2.2 OTA update in June 2022. Driver display Apple Maps support added in P2.9 (May 2023). Retroactively available on all model years. Wired connection only.
spec_note_8: Added via P3.3.16 software update in late 2024. Retroactively available on all model years. Wired connection only.

spec_note_30: Standard on MY21 Launch Edition. Optional extra for other years. Temporarily suspended in mid-2022 (MY22 post-Mar and MY23) due to semiconductor shortages (replaced by Pilot Lite).
spec_note_31: Replaced the full Pilot pack during the chip shortage, omitting the Pixel LED headlights.
spec_note_32: Available only on Long range Dual motor. Includes Öhlins DFV dampers, Brembo gold brakes, forged alloy wheels, and Swedish gold accents. Standard software power upgrade (350 kW / 476 hp) included from MY23 onwards.
spec_note_33: Introduced as a separate package in MY25. For MY22–MY24, these cold-weather features (heat pump, heated steering wheel, heated rear seats, heated wiper nozzles) were bundled within the Plus Pack.
spec_note_34: Introduced in MY25. Includes 20" Pro Graphite wheels, gold-striped seatbelts, and gold valve caps.
spec_note_35: MY26: Replaces Jupiter. Sandy hue with smooth mica finish.
